findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Rollback can restore availability while displaying absent/failed data as measured zero.
findings.plan_claim: UI/API read flags roll back to legacy safely.
findings.contract_claim: Rollback must preserve data truth and null/support semantics.
findings.runtime_fact: Legacy public dashboard converts snapshot absence to an all-zero snapshot and preserves initial zeros on failures.
findings.live_evidence: A4 AF-A4-001 provides exact route/UI evidence.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Technical availability is not a truthful rollback.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not start cutover until rollback target passes truthfulness acceptance.
findings.acceptance_needed: Failure-injection rollback renders correct loading/empty/error/stale/support states.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Without canary and telemetry a cutover becomes all-or-nothing.
findings.plan_claim: Provider/workspace percentage canary, parity/SLO alerts and instant rollback are required.
findings.contract_claim: legacy_dashboard, funnel_api_canary and funnel_api_enabled states are planned.
findings.runtime_fact: No Funnel API route, read cutover flags, canary assignment or cutover telemetry was found.
findings.live_evidence: R9 remains blocked and E13 not started.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: The control plane does not exist yet.
findings.acceptance_needed: Percentage ramp, error budget, parity, lag, rejection and rollback evidence.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Early legacy removal can break active reads, refresh, jobs, audit and rollback.
findings.plan_claim: Retirement only after consumer-zero and stabilization.
findings.contract_claim: Read-disable observation and restore point precede destructive work.
findings.runtime_fact: server.js and public dashboard still own legacy dataset/snapshot/job/connection behavior.
findings.schema_fact: Live V1, snapshot, job, schedule, connection and token tables contain material rows.
findings.live_evidence: V1=4947, snapshots=2185, jobs=2392, schedules=10 versus V2=5.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Consumer-zero is not close; current blocked status is correct.
findings.acceptance_needed: Static and runtime consumer registry reaches zero for the observation period.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Stopping V2 writes can unintentionally resume V1 writes and increase divergence.
findings.plan_claim: V2 write may be separately disabled; V1 data is preserved for rollback.
findings.contract_claim: Read rollback and write control are separate operational decisions.
findings.runtime_fact: Meta/Google V2 primary flags choose V2 when true and actively call legacy V1 writers when false; absent defaults to true.
findings.schema_fact: Both V1 and V2 stores exist.
findings.live_evidence: Current code and tests assert the branch behavior.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Stop, read rollback and legacy-write fallback are conflated.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not use one flag as a universal incident switch.
findings.acceptance_needed: Independent stop-write, read-source and explicit fallback controls with failure-injection tests.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: A real recovery may miss RTO/RPO when only component-level restore readiness exists.
findings.plan_claim: Backup/restore and rollback rehearsal are mandatory before GO.
findings.contract_claim: Restore target and rollback are applied and verified.
findings.runtime_fact: Dataset V2 restore-readiness artefacts exist; no full application rehearsal was found.
findings.schema_fact: Multiple live legacy and canonical stores must be coordinated.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Component readiness is not full recovery evidence.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not infer full restore from Dataset-only artefacts.
findings.remediation_dependency: Stable E11/E12 and cutover control plane.
findings.acceptance_needed: Timed DB/config/deployment/read-path restore rehearsal with RTO/RPO and data-loss evidence.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Shopify-specific assumptions can leak into the common core and make a second commerce adapter expensive or unsafe.
findings.plan_claim: Common workspace/currency/connection/V2 core must not require Shopify identity.
findings.contract_claim: WooCommerce is an adapter readiness check, not an implementation.
findings.runtime_fact: No independent R11/WooCommerce readiness contract or test package was found.
findings.schema_fact: Canonical workspace tables are largely platform-independent; Shopify installation remains an adapter table.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: The decision exists but acceptance artefact does not.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not implement WooCommerce during this audit.
findings.remediation_dependency: Core architecture stabilizes before legacy retirement.
findings.acceptance_needed: Static/schema contract proves common core has no mandatory Shopify identity and defines safe adapter binding.
